results.content:
But the Xiaomi Pad Mini is anything but a cheap imitation of the iPad Mini. It’s a fantastically well-thought-out device sitting in a product segment that desperately needs more competition. It’s an Android-powered alternative to the iPad Mini that finally made me understand why people love small tablets.

With an 8.8-inch screen, the Xiaomi Pad Mini certainly isn’t the smallest tablet you can buy. The iPad Mini has a smaller 8.3-inch display, and a foldable like the Samsung Galaxy Z Fold 7 offers an 8-inch screen when opened. The key difference, though, is the Pad Mini’s aspect ratio, which is much better suited for media consumption. results.content:
### What is the best iPad mini alternative?

A compact Android tablet such as the HONOR Pad X7 can be a good iPad mini alternative if you want a lower-cost tablet for reading, travel, streaming, video calls and everyday use.

### Are Android compact tablets good for reading?

Yes, Android compact tablets are good for casual reading, eBooks, articles and web browsing. If you read PDFs, comics or long documents regularly, the iPad mini’s sharper display gives a better experience.

### Should I buy an iPad mini or Android tablet for travel?

Choose the iPad mini if you want premium performance, sharper display quality and optional 4G/5G connectivity. Choose an Android compact tablet if you want a more affordable travel tablet for Wi-Fi browsing, reading and streaming. [...] ### Best for Streaming

Both can stream well, but the iPad mini gives you the better display and performance. The HONOR Pad X7 is better if you simply want a small tablets option for casual streaming without paying premium Apple prices.

## iPad mini Alternatives: When Android Makes More Sense

The best iPad mini alternatives are not always trying to beat Apple on raw performance. Their main advantage is value. A compact Android tablet makes more sense if:

 You want a lower price.
 You mainly browse, stream and read.
 You are buying for a child.
 You prefer Android and Google apps.
 You want a simple tablet for commuting.
 You need a backup tablet for travel.
 You do not need Apple Pencil Pro or premium gaming performance. [...] |  |  |

## Important Questions

### Is the iPad mini better than Android compact tablets?

Yes, the iPad mini is better for performance, display quality, graphics, Apple Pencil support and long-term premium use. Android compact tablets are better if you want a more affordable device for reading, browsing, streaming and casual daily tasks.

results.title: Best iPad Alternatives: These Tablets Beat Apple In 2026
results.content:
### Lenovo Legion Tab Gen 3: Best iPad Mini Alternative

If you want a small, premium tablet but don’t want an iPad Mini, the Lenovo Legion Tab Gen 3 is basically your only high-end Android option. Almost every other manufacturer in the 8-inch segment is chasing the budget market, so the fact that Lenovo put a Snapdragon 8 Gen 3 into an 8.8-inch device makes this one pretty unique. And in a few key areas, it actually beats the iPad Mini. [...] Best Standard iPad Alternative for Pen Users: Samsung Galaxy Tab S10 Lite (on Amazon)\ A laminated display, an included S Pen, and Samsung Notes. The best pick for handwriting and drawing at this price.
 Best Standard iPad Alternative for Media and Gaming: OnePlus Pad Go 2 (on Amazon)\ A 12.1-inch 120Hz display at 900 nits, four speakers, and clean software for around $399.
 Best iPad Mini Alternative: Lenovo Legion Tab Gen 3 (on Amazon)\ A 165Hz display, no jelly scrolling, and a Snapdragon 8 Gen 3. The only real premium 8-inch Android tablet.
 Best iPad Air Alternative: OnePlus Pad 3 (on Amazon)\ Flagship Snapdragon 8 Elite performance at a lower price than the iPad Air. Fantastic value. [...] Read our full review: Microsoft Surface Pro 12 Review

## Which iPad Alternative Should You Get?

If you’re shopping for a standard iPad alternative and you care about the pen, the Samsung Galaxy Tab S10 Lite is the clear pick thanks to its laminated display and included S Pen. If you’d rather save money and get the biggest, brightest screen for media and browsing, the OnePlus Pad Go 2 at around $250 is hard to beat. For a small, premium tablet, the Lenovo Legion Tab Gen 3 is the best iPad Mini alternative, with a 165Hz display, a Snapdragon 8 Gen 3, and significantly better battery life. The OnePlus Pad 3 is our pick as the best iPad Air alternative, with flagship performance at a lower price.
